name: Ragged Tunic
description: A holey shirt held together by threads.

name: Ragged Pants
description: Pants worn thin with age.

name: Ragged Foot Wrappings
description: Frayed cloth that can be wrapped around your feet for the most basic protection.

name: Ragged Hand Wrappings
description: Frayed cloth that can be wrapped around your hands for the most basic protection.

name: Ragged Hat
description: Frayed cloth that can be wrapped around your head for the most basic protection.

name: Cloth Shirt
description: Simple, rough-spun fabric stitched together for modesty rather than protection. It offers little defense against blades or claws, but at least keeps the chill off.

name: Cloth Pants
description: Plain trousers made from coarse fabric. They cover your legs, but will provide little protection.

name: Cloth Skirt
description: Plain skirt made from coarse fabric. It cover your legs, but will provide little protection.

name: Cloth Shoes
description: Soft-soled shoes stitched from scraps of leather and cloth. They provide comfort for walking, but almost no protection.

name: Cloth Gloves
description: Thin gloves that keep your hands clean, though not safe. They wear out quickly with hard work.

name: Cloth Hat
description: A simple cap, woven more for shade than safety. Offers no defense, but adds a bit of character.

name: Courtier’s Doublet
description: Finely tailored, with silken lining and ornate trim. Offers little protection but man does it look good.

name: Silken Trousers
description: Smooth and shimmering, delicate but luxurious.

name: Silk Skirt
description: Smooth and shimmering, delicate but luxurious.

name: Opera Gloves
description: Silken gloves more for show than practicality.

name: Gilded Slippers
description: Soft shoes with golden thread, too fine for travel.

name: Embroidered Hat
description: A feathered cap.

name: Wooden "Shield"
description: A "shield" salvaged from part of a table or wall.

name: Small Buckler
description: A small round wooden shield.

name: Tower Shield
description: A large shield to cover full body. Not reinforced, so easily broken, but better than nothing.

name: Primative Stone Shield
description: A rough slab of stone lashed to a wooden frame with rawhide. Heavy and unwieldy, but capable of deflecting blows through sheer mass

name: Stone Shield
description: A carefully shaped slab of stone fitted into a sturdy wooden frame. Though still heavy, its smoother surface and balanced construction make it far more reliable in battle.

name: Dwarven Stone Shield
description: Hewn from dense granite and etched with runic patterns, this shield is a masterpiece of dwarven masonry. Perfectly balanced despite its bulk, it offers near-impenetrable defense while channeling the resilience of the mountain itself.

name: Minor Healing Potion
description: Recover a small amount of health.

name: Healing Potion
description: Recover some health.

name: Major Healing Potion
description: Recover a good amount of health.

name: Rock
description: Just a regular rock.

name: Stick
description: A small branch.

name: Cloth
description: A piece of cloth that can be used to craft clothing.

name: Broken Wood Dagger
description: Basically a broken stick. I wouldn't use this to stab a vampire if it was the last stick on earth.

name: Wooden Dagger
description: Wooden dagger (really just a shiv; deals splinter damage).

name: Ornate Wooden Dagger
description: A finely crafted dagger of polished hardwood, its handle etched with delicate patterns. Though still only wood, its elegance makes it more art piece than battlefield weapon.

name: Primative Stone Dagger
description: A jagged shard of flint tied to a stick with sinew. Crude, brittle, and uneven, but dangerous in desperate hands.

name: Stone Dagger
description: A chipped and shaped blade of obsidian, set into a wood hilt.

name: Dwarven Stone Dagger
description: Carved from flawless obsidian and engraved with runes, this blade gleams like dark glass. Perfectly weighted and honed to a razor’s edge.

name: Crude Bronze Dagger
description: A hastily cast weapon with uneven edges, more tool than blade.

name: Refined Bronze Dagger
description: Balanced and sharpened through repeated hammering, the bronze gleams with a well-polished edge.

name: Exquisite Bronze Dagger
description: Expertly crafted with patterned inlays and a keen edge, the weapon seems almost golden in the light.

name: Rusty Iron Dagger
description: A poorly cared-for iron blade, pitted and streaked with rust. Its edge is blunt, and it feels unwieldy in hand, but it can still pierce flesh in desperate situations.

name: Honed Iron Dagger
description: Edges sharpened and polished, smoother and more precise than a crude blade

name: Tempered Iron Dagger
description: Carefully forged and heat-treated, this dagger is balanced and resilient. Its edge holds better than common iron, and it delivers reliable, deadly strikes.

name: Rough Steel Dagger
description: A sturdy blade of basic steel, roughly forged and showing hammer marks. Harder than iron, but still unpolished and slightly unbalanced.

name: Fine Steel Dagger
description: Well-forged and balanced, the steel gleams with a polished edge. Reliable and deadly, it can pierce most armor with skillful strikes.

name: Damascus Steel Dagger
description: A masterpiece of smithing, perfectly balanced with flowing dark-and-light steel patterns. Its edge remains razor-sharp through countless battles, and it feels almost alive in the hand.

name: Tarnished Silver Dagger
description: Once gleaming, this dagger’s blade is now dulled with patches of black tarnish. Its edge is soft compared to steel, but it still bites true against unnatural foes.
notes: good against supernatural, maybe repairs to polished silver dagger

name: Polished Silver Dagger
description: A polished blade of pure silver, smooth and elegant. Though softer than steel, it shines with a brilliance that makes it stand out in any armory.

name: Royal Silver Dagger
description: A masterfully crafted silver blade with gold inlay and a jewel-set hilt. Though delicate in form, it carries both beauty and deadly purpose.

name: Simple Mithril Dagger
description: Forged from shimmering silver-blue metal, this blade is impossibly light yet stronger than steel. Its edge cuts cleanly with little resistance.
notes: speed bonus? also extra light, gives off light??

name: Elven Mithril Dagger
description: Slim and elegant, engraved with flowing runes that glow faintly under moonlight. The balance is flawless, allowing

name: Mythical Mithril Dagger
description: A legendary weapon of near-weightless metal, sharp enough to split armor and stone as if they were cloth. It gleams with an otherworldly radiance.

name: Adamantine Shard Dagger
description: A small, brutally heavy dagger forged from raw adamant. Crude but nearly unbreakable.

name: Forged Adamant Dagger
description: A perfectly tempered adamant blade, its surface reflecting a dull, indigo sheen. Balanced despite its heft, it cuts with unstoppable force.

name: Eternal Adamant Dagger
description: Said to be indestructible, this dagger is a flawless embodiment of adamant’s power. Its edge cannot be dulled, its form cannot be bent, and it bears an aura of permanence.

name: Dragon Fang
description: A dagger fashioned from the sharpened fang of a fallen dragon. Rough and primal, but stronger than Mithril and still humming with dormant power.

name: Drakonium Dagger
description: Forged from the fossilized bones of dragons long extinct, this blade carries the weight of forgotten ages. Pale and ridged like bone, it gleams with a faint inner glow.

name: Wyrmblood Dagger
description: A dagger born from the marrow of an elder dragon, its veins pulsing with crimson light. The blade burns faintly to the touch, resonating with primal fury.

name: Ancient Orichalcum Dagger
description: Recovered from lost ruins. It carries the wisdom and magic of a bygone age.

name: Arcane Orichalcum Dagger
description: Forged from the rarest metal over countless hours, this dagger is imbued with potent spells. Each strike can unleash unpredictable effects

name: Poison
description: A vile substance that seeps into wounds or drink, slowly sapping strength and vitality from its victim.

name: Pine Log
description: A light, resinous log with a fresh forest scent, easy to cut and shape but not the most durable.

name: Healing Poison
description: would be funny to have ability to make potions that effects cancel each other out
